title: Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 学习引导大型语言模型智能体与多智能体系统

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. However, these systems are prone to deviating from the overall goal as execution unfolds, which wastes execution resources and leads to undesired outcomes, a failure termed goal drift . In this work, we propose a steering agent that supervises execution on the fly and steers the system back on track when drift occurs. The steering agent observes the execution context, deciding when to intervene with a low-cost fast path and how to intervene with a high-cost slow path. To unlock its steering intelligence, the ability to assess goal drift and generate effective interventions, we jointly train the two paths with reinforcement learning, combining a pairwise ranking objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). Experiments on information-seeking search tasks show that the steering agent provides effective supervision for both single-agent and multi-agent systems, improving their performance and efficiency. The learned steering intelligence generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, transfers to unseen executors, and supports controllable intervention frequency without retraining.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Xi et al., 2025 ) and multi-agent systems (MAS) ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use ( Schick et al., 2023 ) and inter-agent collaboration ( Hong et al., 2024 ) , spanning information seeking ( Team et al., 2025 ) , software engineering ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , and scientific discovery ( Qu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . However, these systems are prone to goal drift , where agents deviate from the overall goal as execution unfolds ( Arike et al., 2025 ; Cemri et al., 2025 ; Laban et al., 2026 ) . A single agent may persist along an unproductive chain of actions, while an agent in a MAS may prioritize its local objective over the collective goal. Goal drift can waste execution resources and lead to undesired outcomes, even when individual actions appear locally reasonable ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026a ) .

paragraphs.en: To keep agents on track and ensure goals are achieved during long-horizon execution, prevalent agent systems, such as Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2026a ) and Codex ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , employ planning and verification ( Young, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2026b ) . As illustrated in Fig. 1 , planning decomposes a goal into manageable subgoals ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , but execution may still deviate from the planned route. Verification checks whether the goal has been achieved before termination, but such post-hoc remediation can lead to irreversible consequences and costly retries. These limitations motivate a natural design of on-the-fly supervision , where an external agent monitors execution and steers the system back toward its goal when drift occurs, complementing planning and verification.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在长期执行过程中让智能体保持正轨并确保目标得以实现，主流的智能体系统（如 Claude Code (Anthropic, 2026a) 和 Codex (OpenAI, 2025)）采用了规划与验证机制 (Young, 2025; Anthropic, 2026b)。 如图 1 所示，规划将目标分解为可管理的子目标 (Wang et al., 2023)，但执行过程仍可能偏离原定路线。 验证会在执行终止前检查目标是否达成，但这种事后补救可能导致不可逆转的后果和高成本的重试。 这些局限性促使人们提出一种自然的实时监督设计：由一个外部智能体监控执行过程，并在出现偏差时将系统重新引导至目标方向，从而对规划与验证形成补充。

paragraphs.en: Such supervision is conceptually straightforward but challenging for the LLM backbone. It requires steering intelligence , the ability to assess execution against the overall goal, determine when intervention is needed, and generate actions that steer systems back on track. Such a capability is established in other goal-directed systems, such as direct supervision in organizations ( Mintzberg, 1979 ) , supervisory control of automated systems ( Sheridan, 1992 ) , and metacognitive monitoring and control in human cognition ( Nelson & Narens, 1990 ) . We bring this principle to LLM agent systems by building a steering agent and improving its steering intelligence through post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 这种监督在概念上看似简单，但对大型语言模型（LLM）主干而言却充满挑战。 它需要引导智能性——即评估执行过程与整体目标契合度的能力，判断何时需要干预，并生成能将系统重新引回正轨的行动。 其他以目标为导向的系统已具备此类能力，例如组织中的直接监督（Mintzberg, 1979）、自动化系统的监督控制（Sheridan, 1992），以及人类认知中的元认知监控与控制（Nelson & Narens, 1990）。 我们通过构建一个引导智能体，并通过训练后优化其引导智能性，将这一原则应用于 LLM 智能体系统。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, we define an observation space that exposes the task goal and execution context of the agent system to the steering agent. During execution, each observation update triggers a decision about whether and, if needed, how to intervene. These two demands motivate a natural design with fast and slow paths ( Kahneman, 2011 ; Su et al., 2025 ; Lampson, 1983 ; Clark et al., 1989 ) . The fast path estimates steering priority through a low-cost single-token prediction. A threshold on this priority controls activation of the slow path, which leverages more costly reasoning to generate steering actions. By separating fast judgment from deliberative generation, this design balances monitoring efficiency and steering effectiveness. We then improve the steering intelligence of the steering agent by jointly training the two paths with reinforcement learning, combining a pairwise ranking objective ( Burges et al., 2005 ) for fast-path steering judgment with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) for slow-path action generation.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，我们定义了一个观察空间，将智能体系统的任务目标和执行上下文暴露给引导智能体。 在执行过程中，每次观察更新都会触发一个决策：是否需要干预，以及如果需要的话应如何干预。 这两种需求促使我们采用一种包含快速路径和慢速路径的自然设计（Kahneman, 2011；Su et al., 2025；Lampson, 1983；Clark et al., 1989）。 快速路径通过低成本的单标记预测来评估引导优先级。 该优先级的阈值用于控制慢速路径的激活，而慢速路径则利用成本更高的推理过程来生成引导动作。 通过将快速判断与审慎生成分离，这种设计在监控效率与引导有效性之间实现了平衡。 接着，我们通过强化学习联合训练这两条路径，来提升引导智能体的引导能力：将用于快速路径引导判断的成对排序目标（Burges et al., 2005）与用于慢速路径动作生成的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）（Shao et al., 2024）相结合。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our steering approach on information-seeking search tasks ( Mialon et al., 2024 ; Ho et al., 2020 ) in both single-agent and multi-agent settings. Our single-agent experiments show that steering is challenging even for a capable LLM backbone, and that reinforcement learning substantially improves steering intelligence. Across seven question-answering benchmarks, zero-shot steering yields a performance gain of only 1.84 points, whereas the RL-optimized steering agent improves performance by 6.66 points with only 0.93 steering actions per task. Furthermore, the steering intelligence generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, transfers to unseen executors, and supports controllable intervention frequency without retraining, with steering at the highest frequency raising the gain to 17.11 points. In the multi-agent setting, we introduce the steering agent into a five-role multi-agent system ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . In this more challenging steering task, where zero-shot supervision degrades performance, the RL-trained steering agent achieves a gain of 5.34 points.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在单智能体和多智能体设置中，通过信息搜索任务（Mialon 等人，2024；Ho 等人，2020）对我们的引导方法进行了评估。 我们的单智能体实验表明，即使对于能力强大的 LLM 基础模型而言，引导仍然具有挑战性，而强化学习能够显著提升引导智能水平。 在七个问答基准测试中，零样本引导仅带来 1.84 分的性能提升，而经过强化学习优化的引导智能体则仅以每次任务 0.93 次引导动作就提升了 6.66 分。 此外，这种引导智能能够泛化到域外任务、迁移到未见过的执行者，并支持无需重新训练的频率可控干预；当引导频率最高时，性能提升可达 17.11 分。 在多智能体设置中，我们将引导智能体引入一个包含五个角色的多智能体系统（Xu 等人，2026）。 在这个更具挑战性的引导任务中，零样本监督会导致性能下降，而经过强化学习训练的引导智能体实现了 5.34 分的性能提升。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下。

paragraphs.en: We characterize goal drift in single- and multi-agent systems, where local objectives can displace the overall task goal, and motivate on-the-fly supervision to keep execution on track.
paragraphs.zh: 我们描述了单智能体和多智能体系统中的目标漂移现象，其中局部目标可能会偏离整体任务目标，并由此催生了实时监督机制，以确保执行过程不偏离正轨。

paragraphs.en: We develop a steering agent with fast intervention judgment and deliberative action generation, and improve its steering intelligence through reinforcement learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种具备快速干预判断和审慎行动生成能力的引导智能体，并通过强化学习提升其引导智能。

paragraphs.en: We conduct experiments on both single- and multi-agent settings, where the steering agent demonstrates effective performance gains, strong generalizability, transferability, and controllability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在单智能体和多智能体两种设置下进行了实验，结果表明，引导智能体在性能提升、泛化能力、迁移能力和可控性方面均表现出显著优势。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based single- and multi-agent systems are increasingly applied to complex, long-horizon tasks, including information-seeking research ( Manus, 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ) , software engineering ( OpenAI, 2025 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , and scientific discovery ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Qu et al., 2026 ) . However, as increasingly complex tasks require longer execution horizons, these systems may deviate from their original task objectives, a failure mode known as goal drift ( Arike et al., 2025 ; Cemri et al., 2025 ; Laban et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的单智能体和多智能体系统正越来越多地应用于复杂且长期规划的任务，包括信息检索类研究（Manus, 2025；Team 等, 2025）、软件工程（OpenAI, 2025；DeepSeek-AI, 2026）以及科学发现（Zhu 等, 2026；Qu 等, 2026）。 然而，随着任务复杂性的提升和执行时间窗口的延长，这些系统可能会偏离其原始任务目标，这种失效模式被称为“目标漂移”（Arike 等, 2025；Cemri 等, 2025；Laban 等, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: To better equip LLMs for long-horizon interaction and multi-agent collaboration, recent work has explored agentic post-training, particularly reinforcement learning (RL) ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2025 ) . Long-horizon agentic RL optimizes LLMs end-to-end with tools on complex tasks requiring extended interaction ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Multi-agent RL jointly optimizes collaborating agents under shared task-level objectives, encouraging individual agents to contribute to overall task success ( Liao et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . However, long-horizon rollouts can make training computationally expensive ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , and RL fine-tuning can overfit to the training environment, affecting the generalization ability of the foundation model ( Aissi et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Lv et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, we keep the task-executing LLMs frozen and train an external agent to supervise execution and steer the system back toward its overall goal when drift occurs.
paragraphs.zh: 为了更好地让大型语言模型（LLM）适应长期互动和多智能体协作，近期的研究探索了智能体导向的后训练方法，特别是强化学习（RL）（Chen et al., 2025b；Wang et al., 2025；Liao et al., 2025）。 长期智能体强化学习通过工具对大型语言模型进行端到端优化，以应对需要长时间互动的复杂任务（Gao et al., 2025；Team et al., 2025；Jiang et al., 2026）。 多智能体强化学习在共享的任务级目标下对协作的智能体进行联合优化，鼓励每个智能体为整体任务的成功做出贡献（Liao et al., 2025；Zhao et al., 2026）。 然而，长期执行过程可能导致训练计算成本高昂（Gao et al., 2025），而强化学习微调可能会过度拟合训练环境，从而影响基础模型的泛化能力（Aissi et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2026b；Lv et al., 2026）。 相比之下，我们将执行任务的大型语言模型保持冻结状态，并训练一个外部智能体来监督执行过程，并在系统偏离目标时将其引导回整体目标。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate goal drift during long-horizon execution, prevalent agent systems ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ; Young, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2025 ) employ planning and verification to support reliable execution. Planning decomposes a goal into manageable subgoals that guide subsequent actions ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . Verification checks whether goals have been met before an agent declares completion, prompting further execution or revision when needed ( Anthropic, 2026b ; Lopopolo, 2026 ) . However, a plan does not ensure reliable execution ( Sinha et al., 2026 ) , while verification may uncover deviations after substantial effort has already been spent.
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解长期执行过程中目标漂移的问题，主流智能体系统（DeepSeek-AI，2026；Young，2025；OpenAI，2025）采用规划与验证方法以支持可靠的执行。 规划将目标分解为可管理的子目标，从而指导后续行动（Wang 等，2023）。 验证会在智能体宣布任务完成之前检查目标是否已达成，并在必要时触发进一步执行或修正（Anthropic，2026b；Lopopolo，2026）。 然而，规划本身并不能保证执行的可靠性（Sinha 等，2026），而验证则可能在大量工作已经完成之后才发现偏差。

paragraphs.en: These limitations motivate a natural on-the-fly supervision design, where an external supervisor monitors intermediate execution and intervenes when goal drift occurs. Recent work explores this idea with a primary focus on detection, identifying when and where an agent goes wrong ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Baidya et al., 2026 ) . SupervisorAgent ( Lin et al., 2026 ) takes a step toward correction by prompting an external LLM, but it targets easily fixable issues such as errors and repetitive actions. Goal drift, however, is more challenging to detect and correct in real time, as it emerges gradually from locally plausible actions. In this paper, we address this challenge with a steering agent that jointly learns drift detection and correction through reinforcement learning.

paragraphs.en: An LLM-based agent executes a task with an overall goal g g by interacting with an environment ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . At each step, the agent generates an action conditioned on g g and the interaction history, and receives environment feedback. A multi-agent system distributes this process across specialized agents, where each agent handles a temporary subgoal derived from g g , such as retrieving evidence or verifying an answer, and hands its output to subsequent agents. In both settings, execution unfolds as a sequence of temporary subgoals in service of the overall goal ( March & Simon, 1958 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过与环境交互，以达成整体目标 g g 来执行任务（Yao 等人，2023）。 在每个步骤中，智能体会根据 g g 和交互历史生成一个动作，并接收环境的反馈。 多智能体系统将这一过程分配给多个专业化智能体，其中每个智能体负责处理从 g g 派生出的临时子目标（例如检索证据或验证答案），并将其输出传递给后续的智能体。 在这两种设定中，执行过程都表现为为实现整体目标而服务的临时子目标的序列（March & Simon，1958）。

paragraphs.en: In LLM-based agent systems, goal drift appears when a temporary subgoal dominates the overall task goal ( Arike et al., 2025 ) , leading to unproductive actions that might be locally reasonable. Goal drift reduces execution efficiency by consuming resources on actions that contribute little to task completion. If the deviation remains uncorrected, the agent system may never finish the task or finish it with an undesired outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 在基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统中，当某个临时子目标压倒整体任务目标时，就会出现目标漂移现象（Arike 等人，2025），从而导致一些局部看似合理但并无实际成效的行动。 目标漂移会因将资源消耗在对任务完成贡献甚微的行动上，而降低执行效率。 如果这种偏差得不到纠正，智能体系统可能永远无法完成任务，或者最终以一个不理想的结局完成它。

paragraphs.en: For example, in multi-hop search tasks ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Yang et al., 2018 ) , the agent needs to retrieve several distinct pieces of evidence and combine them to answer a question, which involves a sequence of temporary retrieval subgoals. A common failure mode is that the agent keeps searching over the same topic when key information has already been obtained. As shown in Fig. 2 (a), the first search already identifies the actress required to answer the question. The agent spends three more searches on the same film instead of moving on to the next step, consistent with observed patterns of redundant and unproductive search ( Liu et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 例如，在多跳搜索任务中（Ho 等人，2020；Yang 等人，2018），智能体需要检索多个不同的证据并将其组合起来以回答问题，这涉及一系列临时的检索子目标。 一种常见的失败模式是，在已经获取关键信息的情况下，智能体仍持续搜索同一主题。 如图 2(a) 所示，第一次搜索就已经确定了回答该问题所需的演员。 该智能体又花费了三次搜索在同一部电影上，而不是进入下一步，这与观察到的冗余且无益的搜索模式一致（Liu 等人，2026a）。

paragraphs.en: In a multi-agent system, where specialized agents collaborate on a complex task, goal drift arises similarly when an agent prioritizes its role objective over the overall task goal. A commonly observed failure mode is over-rejection, where a verifier falsely rejects results that already satisfy the task goal ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Stechly et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . As shown in Fig. 2 (b), the verifier repeatedly rejects the answers the searchers have delivered, leading execution to repeated revision rounds that can turn a successful execution into a failure. This reflects the verifier overweighting its own goal of admitting only answers beyond doubt.
paragraphs.zh: 在多智能体系统中，当专业智能体共同协作完成一项复杂任务时，如果某个智能体将自身角色目标置于整体任务目标之上，同样会出现目标偏移的问题。 一种常见的失效模式是过度拒绝，即验证器错误地拒绝了那些已经满足任务目标的结果（Huang et al., 2024 ; Stechly et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025）。 如图 2 (b) 所示，验证器反复拒绝搜索者提供的答案，导致执行过程不断进入修订轮次，甚至可能使一次成功的执行最终失败。 这反映出验证器过度重视自身“仅接受无可争议的答案”这一目标。

paragraphs.en: Effective steering requires steering intelligence, the ability to assess execution against the overall goal, determine when intervention is needed, and generate actions that bring execution back on track. paragraphs.en: In this section, we conduct experiments to study three research questions. paragraphs.en: We follow the experimental setting of ASearcher ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , which trains on ASearcher-Base-35k and evaluates on seven retrieval-augmented QA benchmarks of multi-hop reasoning and single-hop retrieval with a local Wikipedia retrieval server. paragraphs.en: Zero-shot steering brings the largest gain among the three supervision forms and leaves executor turns nearly unchanged. In comparison, zero-shot planning and verification help less or even degrade performance and lengthen execution. These results show that intervening during execution supervises the executor more effectively than planning ahead or reviewing afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 零样本引导在三种监督形式中带来了最大的提升，并且几乎未改变执行者的行为。 相比之下，零样本规划和验证的辅助作用较小，甚至可能降低性能并延长执行时间。 这些结果表明，在执行过程中进行干预比提前规划或事后审查能更有效地监督执行者。

paragraphs.en: To examine the improvement brought by reinforcement learning, we apply the same learning algorithm (Section 3.3 ) to the steering, planning, and verification agents. RL improves all three supervision forms over their zero-shot counterparts. Among them, steering benefits the most. RL raises the gain from 1.84 to 6.66 points and reaches the strongest results consistently on all seven benchmarks, with the fewest steering actions and executor turns. These results show that reinforcement learning effectively unlocks the steering intelligence, enabling the steering agent to mitigate goal drift.

paragraphs.en: To study whether the learned steering intelligence generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, we further evaluate on tasks that require an online search API, which exposes more complex real-world information. We test the same steering model without additional training on three more challenging benchmarks that require deeper multi-hop search, namely Frames ( Krishna et al., 2025 ) , GAIA ( Mialon et al., 2024 ) , and xBench-DeepSearch ( Chen et al., 2025a ) (Table 2 ). Steering improves both Avg@4 and Pass@4 on Frames and GAIA, and raises Pass@4 on xBench-DeepSearch. These results show that the learned steering capability generalizes beyond the training distribution. The steering agent mainly learns to recognize and correct goal drift, while task-specific ability stays within the frozen executor, which mitigates overfitting to the training tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究所学到的引导智能体是否能够泛化到域外任务，我们进一步在需要在线搜索 API 的任务上进行了评估，这些任务涉及更复杂的现实世界信息。 我们在另外三个更具挑战性的基准测试中测试了相同的引导模型，无需额外训练；这些测试需要更深入的跨步搜索，即 Frames（Krishna 等人，2025）、GAIA（Mialon 等人，2024）和 xBench-DeepSearch（Chen 等人，2025a）（表 2）。 引导机制在 Frames 和 GAIA 上提升了 Avg@4 和 Pass@4，并在 xBench-DeepSearch 上提高了 Pass@4。 这些结果表明，所学到的引导能力能够泛化到训练分布之外的任务。 引导智能体主要学会识别并纠正目标偏移，而任务特定的能力则保留在冻结的执行器中，从而减少了对训练任务的过拟合。

To test whether the steering intelligence learned with one execution model can transfer across different model families, we use the same steering model to supervise three unseen executors, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) and Phi-4 ( Abdin et al., 2024 ) . As shown in Table 3 , zero-shot steering behaves consistently across the four model families and brings small gains. The steering agent trained with the Qwen executor shows strong transferability, improving the three unseen executors by 15.78, 12.01, and 5.92 points while effectively reducing the executor turns. These results show that the learned steering intelligence transfers to executors unseen during training, allowing the executor to be freely switched without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试通过一种执行模型学习到的引导智能体是否能够在不同模型家族之间迁移，我们使用相同的引导模型来监督三个未见的执行器：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（Grattafiori 等人，2024）、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3（Jiang 等人，2023）和 Phi-4（Abdin 等人，2024）。 如表 3 所示，零样本引导在这四个模型家族中表现一致，并带来了小幅提升。 使用 Qwen 执行器训练的引导智能体展现出强大的迁移能力，使三个未见的执行器分别提升了 15.78、12.01 和 5.92 分，同时有效减少了执行器的轮次。 这些结果表明，学习到的引导智能体能够迁移到训练期间未接触过的执行器上，从而可以在不重新训练的情况下自由切换执行器。

paragraphs.en: We further examine the controllability of the intervention frequency by varying the threshold of Equation 4 at deployment without retraining. We visualize the total gain and the gain per intervention in Figure 4 . In the left panel, RL steering consistently improves task performance across all intervention budgets, surpassing zero-shot steering, Filtered BC, and the planning and verification baselines. At the highest intervention frequency, RL steering raises the total gain to 17.11 points. These results show that the fast path design turns intervention frequency into a deployment-time control, allowing the same model to trade steering cost for task performance. In the right panel, RL steering achieves its largest gain per intervention at low intervention frequency, while zero-shot steering and filtered BC remain low across frequencies, lacking the ability to judge where intervention matters most. This demonstrates that the fast path learns to prioritize steering at the states that influence the final outcome most, yielding the largest gain under a fixed intervention budget.

paragraphs.en: We further conduct experiments on the multi-agent setting. Following TacoMAS ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , we build a five-role pipeline for search tasks, where agents with specialized roles collaborate in a fixed order, details of which are provided in Appendix A.4 . The observation space of the steering agent is the task goal and inter-agent handoffs. The action space includes appending a guidance note or rejecting the message for retry. The steering agent, the training procedure, and the benchmarks stay the same as in the single-agent experiments. Table 4 reports the F1 metrics, with cost measured by steering actions (#Act.) and agent turns (Turns), the total number of actions executed by agents in the MAS.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步在多智能体设置下进行了实验。 遵循 TacoMAS（Xu 等人，2026），我们为搜索任务构建了一个包含五个角色的流程，其中具有专门角色的智能体按照固定顺序协作，相关细节见附录 A.4。 引导智能体的观察空间包括任务目标以及智能体之间的消息传递。 动作空间包括附加指导说明或拒绝消息以重试。 引导智能体、训练流程以及基准测试均与单智能体实验中的设置保持一致。 表 4 报告了 F1 指标，其中成本通过引导动作（#Act.）和智能体轮次（Turns）来衡量，即 MAS 中智能体执行的动作总数。

paragraphs.en: Results show that supervising an MAS with lower granularity is more challenging for the steering agent. With the threshold of Equation 4 tuned so that steering actions cover 25% of agent turns, zero-shot steering lowers the average F1 by 1.04 points. Forcing steering at every handoff increases the drop to 7.14 points, with agent turns inflated from 9.2 to 24.1 per task. In comparison, our RL algorithm effectively improves the steering intelligence, achieving gains of 3.90 and 5.34 points under the two frequency settings, respectively. These results show that the same steering interface and learning algorithm are applicable to both fine-grained supervision of a single agent and coarse-grained supervision of a multi-agent system.

paragraphs.en: This paper targets goal drift in LLM-based agent systems and builds a steering agent that decides when to intervene with a low-cost fast path and how with a deliberative slow path. Joint reinforcement learning over the two paths unlocks steering intelligence that improves both single-agent and multi-agent systems, generalizes to out-of-domain tasks, transfers to unseen executors, and supports controllable intervention frequency. As LLM-based agents and multi-agent systems tackle increasingly complex and long-horizon tasks, the steering agent provides an effective on-the-fly supervision tool to improve their performance and efficiency.

paragraphs.en: Single agent and multi-agent experiments share the same training setup. During training, the steering agent is initialized from Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . The backbone of the execution agent system is Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2024 ) , which is served separately and excluded from parameter updates. We train with AdamW ( Loshchilov & Hutter, 2017 ) at a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} and a batch size of 64 tasks for 300 steps. The task reward R R , first defined in Section 3.2 , is instantiated as answer token F1 multiplied by a trajectory-format indicator. The F1 term measures the word-level overlap between the predicted and the reference answers, and the indicator is 1 when every executor turn commits exactly one well-formed action tag and 0 otherwise. The remaining reinforcement learning hyperparameters follow the defaults of the ASearcher framework.

paragraphs.en: Each task performs m = 2 m=2 selection rounds over the state bank, and each round selects up to k = 3 k=3 states. Each selection takes a uniformly random state with probability ε sel = 0.25 \varepsilon_{\mathrm{sel}}=0.25 and otherwise the state with the highest steering priority. Every selected state receives its full group of G = 4 G=4 steering actions. Each steered and unsteered state is evaluated by N = 2 N=2 executor continuations, whose means give R ¯ s , j \bar{R}_{s,j} and the baseline b s b_{s} in Equation 7 . All new states reached by the continuations are added to the state bank.

paragraphs.en: The in-domain evaluation data of ASearcher ( Gao et al., 2025 ) includes seven retrieval-augmented QA benchmarks, totaling 6,125 questions with 1,000 sampled questions from each benchmark and the full 125 questions of Bamboogle. 2WikiMultiHopQA ( Ho et al., 2020 ) builds multi-hop questions from Wikipedia and Wikidata with annotated reasoning paths. HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) contains two-hop questions that bridge or compare Wikipedia entities. Bamboogle ( Press et al., 2023 ) collects hand-written compositional questions that a standard search engine answers incorrectly. MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) composes questions of two to four hops from single-hop ones with stricter connectivity requirements. Natural Questions ( Kwiatkowski et al., 2019 ) contains real search-engine queries answered by Wikipedia. TriviaQA ( Joshi et al., 2017 ) contains trivia questions authored by quiz enthusiasts. PopQA ( Mallen et al., 2023 ) probes long-tail entity knowledge with templated questions built from Wikidata triples.

paragraphs.en: The verification agent is triggered after the executor commits an answer and decides whether the submission stands. It either passes the answer or rejects it with feedback. paragraphs.en: The filtered BC baseline ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2021 ) collects the steering actions sampled by the same rollout pipeline as our online RL algorithm and keeps those whose mean reward R ¯ s , j \bar{R}_{s,j} exceeds the unsteered baseline b s b_{s} in Equation 7 . paragraphs.en: The multi-agent system adapts the five-role template of TacoMAS ( Xu et al., 2026 ) to search tasks. A planner decomposes the question into subgoals and dispatches them to two searchers, which retrieve evidence in parallel. A verifier reviews the searchers’ deliverables against the question, and a summarizer composes the final answer from the delivered evidence and the verifier’s verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 该多智能体系统将 TacoMAS（Xu 等人，2026）的五角色模板应用于任务搜索。 一个规划器将问题分解为子目标，并将其分配给两个搜索器，后者并行检索证据。 一个验证器根据问题审查搜索器的交付成果，而一个总结器则从提供的证据和验证器的判断中构建最终答案。

paragraphs.en: To examine the actual cost of the low-cost fast path and the high-cost slow path, we measure their latency on the trained steering agent served by SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) . We collect the latency data during the in-domain evaluation of Table 1 and report the average latency per call at 12 concurrent requests per GPU. As shown in Figure 6 , the two paths read the same context and therefore share the same prefill cost of about 0.2 s. The fast path then decodes the decision token and finishes within 0.3 s, while the slow path generates about 1.8k reasoning and action tokens on average and takes 30 s. These results show that the fast-slow design effectively separates the cost of judgment from the cost of intervention, allowing the fast path to run at every observation update while the slow path conducts reasoning only when triggered.
paragraphs.zh: 为了考察低成本快速路径和高成本慢速路径的实际开销，我们在由 SGLang（Zheng 等人，2024）服务的训练好的引导智能体上测量了它们的延迟。 我们在表 1 的领域内评估过程中收集了延迟数据，并报告了每 GPU 12 个并发请求时的每次调用的平均延迟。 如图 6 所示，两条路径读取相同的上下文，因此共享约 0.2 秒的相同预填充开销。 快速路径随后解码决策令牌并在 0.3 秒内完成，而慢速路径平均生成约 1.8k 个推理和行动令牌，耗时 30 秒。 这些结果表明，快慢设计有效地区分了判断的开销与干预的开销，使得快速路径可以在每次观察更新时运行，而慢速路径仅在触发时进行推理。

paragraphs.en: To examine whether the in-domain results depend on the token F1 metric, we follow ASearcher ( Gao et al., 2025 ) to supplement LLM-as-a-Judge (LasJ) accuracy for all methods in Table 1 . The RL improved steering agent achieves the best results consistently on all seven benchmarks, and RL raises the gain of steering from 1.60 to 6.77 points. paragraphs.zh: 为了检验领域内结果是否依赖于词元 F1 指标，我们遵循 ASearcher（Gao 等人，2025），为表 1 中的所有方法补充了 LLM-as-a-Judge（LasJ）准确率。 评判模型和提示模板与领域外评估中的相同（附录 A.2）。 如表 5 所示，LasJ 准确率呈现出与表 1 相同的趋势。 经过强化学习改进的引导智能体在所有七个基准测试中始终取得最佳结果，且强化学习将引导增益从 1.60 提升至 6.77 分。 总体而言，LasJ 准确率高于词元 F1，因为评判模型会接受那些在语义上与参考答案一致但表面形式不同的回答。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we list the full prompt templates used in the experiments. Curly-braced slots are filled at run time from the current observation. In the single-agent setting, the slots carry the question, the executor’s rendered action history, the action count with the remaining turn budget, and a line naming the executor’s currently legal actions. A committed note is injected into the executor’s prompt under the header “A steering supervisor has reviewed your progress and left a note for your next action (follow the note):”. In the multi-agent setting, the slots carry the task, the rendered pipeline, the handoffs delivered so far, the submission under review with its sender and recipients, and any rejection feedback already issued at this handoff. The planning and verification prompts share the single-agent context, with the role statement adapted to their placement. The last box lists the LLM-as-Judge prompt of the out-of-domain evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们列出了实验中使用的完整提示模板。 花括号内的占位符会在运行时根据当前观察结果进行填充。 在单智能体设置中，这些占位符包含问题、执行者已执行的动作历史、动作计数及剩余回合预算，以及一行说明执行者当前合法动作的名称。 一条已提交的注释会被注入到执行者的提示中，标题为“一位引导主管已审阅您的进展，并为您的下一步行动留下了注释（请遵循该注释）：”。 在多智能体设置中，这些占位符包含任务、已生成的流程、迄今完成的交接、正在审核的提交及其发送者和接收者，以及在此交接阶段已发出的任何拒绝反馈。 规划与验证提示共享单智能体上下文，其角色说明会根据各自的位置进行调整。 最后一个框列出了域外评估中“LLM作为裁判”的提示。
